name: silvertongue
description: Write like anyone famous: search studied writing voices and write your point in one, with every source linked.

interface.longDescription: Search famous writing voices, each studied from what the person actually published, and write your own point in one for a post, reply, explanation or thread. Voices are unofficial: nobody named wrote or endorsed them, and drafts are never presented as their words.
capabilities: Read a voice's sources and limits
Write in a voice for a format and platform
defaultPrompt: Write my launch post in Theo Von's voice, short, for X.
Which comedy voices are there, and what does each one do?
Rewrite this reply in Ricky Gervais's voice, clean edge.

positive.description: Find voices that suit a piece of writing
positive.prompt: Which voices would suit a launch post for my note-taking app? Show me three and what each one is good at.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists three voices from the search with each one's lane, what it does, and its strengths and limits.

positive.description: See how a voice was studied
positive.prompt: Show me how the Gordon Ramsay voice was studied.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the voice's profile, every source studied with a note on what it shows, and the line saying the profile is unofficial.

positive.description: Write a reply in a voice, keeping the user's facts
positive.prompt: Write my reply to this post in Snoop Dogg's voice, short, for X, and keep my point that the launch moved to Tuesday: "Anyone know when the new release is out?"
positive.expected_behavior: Gets the packet for a short reply on X and writes the reply in the voice, as the user, saying the launch moved to Tuesday and adding no new facts.

positive.prompt: Now write the same reply in William Shakespeare's voice.
positive.expected_behavior: Gets the new voice's packet, which replaces the earlier voice, and rewrites the same reply with the same facts in the new voice.

positive.prompt: Which Silvertongue voices have been added or re-studied?
positive.expected_behavior: With nothing cached, lists every current voice as added, with each voice's name and lane.

negative.description: A question with nothing to write
Plain editing with no voice asked for
negative.prompt: Fix the grammar in this sentence: their going to the meeting tomorow.

negative.description: Posting on the user's behalf, which Silvertongue never does
negative.prompt: Post this to my X account for me: shipping next week.

publication.release_notes: First release: search 50 famous writing voices, read how each one was studied, and write a post, reply, explanation or thread in one with your own model.
